name: io.github.dobo123123/dobocache
title: DoboCache
description: One-command adoption: detects installed Loomy desktop / opencode / Claude Code configs, backs them up, wires a self-starting MCP entry plus autostart, and runs a local proxy that keeps prompt-cache prefixes stable so provider prompt caching actually hits. Other MCP clients mount manually. Fully local, no telemetry.

environmentVariables.name: DOBOCACHE_LOG_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the local white-box JSONL log. Absolute path recommended. Optional; defaults to the platform log directory: %LOCALAPPDATA%\DoboCache\logs on Windows, ~/Library/Logs/DoboCache on macOS, $XDG_STATE_HOME/dobocache (fallback ~/.local/state/dobocache) on Linux.

environmentVariables.name: DOBOCACHE_WHITEBOX
environmentVariables.description: White-box report card mode: quiet (default, no card in tool output, log only), once (one card next call, then back to quiet), always (card on every call, ~300+ tokens each). Unrecognized values fall back to quiet with a warning. Cumulative stats are always available via cf_report at no token cost.

environmentVariables.name: DOBOCACHE_HIT_PRICE_PER_M
environmentVariables.description: Optional price per million tokens for cache-hit tokens used in savings estimates.

environmentVariables.name: DOBOCACHE_MISS_PRICE_PER_M
environmentVariables.description: Optional price per million tokens for cache-miss tokens used in savings estimates.
